files.jobs/registry.py:
import json
from importlib import import_module
from pathlib import Path

def run_job(name, label):
    config = json.loads(Path("config/interface-registry.json").read_text())
    module, function = config[name].rsplit(".", 1)
    return getattr(import_module(module), function)(label)
